units: All returns in percent, gaps in percentage points. No cost deduction. First observed NAV rebased to one for both paths; no synthetic pre-observation starting capital.
partition: FULL + two equal elapsed calendar-time halves; first actual observation at/after midpoint starts half two; exclude cross-boundary windows from half summaries.
calendarWindows: All scheduled origins; exact +6/+12 calendar months; weekly first stored union endpoint on/after target within7 days, verified daily first exchange session on/after target. No interpolation or inner join.
sessionWindows: H126/H252 only when exact full paired date grid equals XKRX/XNYS or frozen #286 declared XKRX calendar. Session transitions i to i+H, not weekly counts or original source holding-label reinterpretation.
missingness: Union plus expected daily sessions; invalid/missing values are not zero; missing whole-path observations block whole-path statistics. All window statuses counted including maturity after asOf, mature unavailable endpoints, gap/interior missing and time-split crossing.
inference: None. Rolling means/win rates/tails descriptive; disjoint greedy calendar windows reported separately and not called independent. No bootstrap/p-value/model ranking.
classification: Observed CAGR, MDD, period lower-tail mean and period volatility partial ordering with no risk-aversion coefficient. Descriptive only, not a preregistered alpha hypothesis. Regardless of path dominance, original source limits prevent investment admission/promotion.
unknowns: No positions/trades consumed: turnover, exact added cost stress and selection alpha unavailable. QQQ has no authorized retained path.
sameSample: Only original complete #286 NAVs within original window/sample/cost scenario; original incomplete paths blocked, never stitch standalone blocks.
